rationale.colonization: 外围丘陵拓展有一定移居内容，但非主线。
rationale.complexity: 外交、地区探索、氏族和金融门槛交织。
rationale.dark_story: 有强邻战争和氏族冲突，但非恐怖政策主导。
rationale.difficulty: 寻龙地域要求与地图局势会互相牵制，未作实机测评。
rationale.diplomacy: 结盟、接纳狗头人少数群体及蓝巾会合作很重要。
rationale.early_pressure: 两省小国处在命令秩序及东洲强邻间。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 巴尔里斯寻访、占卜和巨龙信仰驱动剧情。
rationale.narrative_density: 从贤者教诲到寻找巨龙，再到宪制改革有完整转折。
rationale.tall_play: 氏族设施、神庙、宫殿和银行建设有连续前置。
rationale.trade_economy: 金矿通胀、银行及跨国货币合作是重要路线。
rationale.warfare: 邻国与命令秩序构成扩张压力。

identity.appearance: 1444年两省金鳞狗头人贤者议会神权国；法克斯·阿卡尔在位
identity.formation_scope: 开局Y85，寻龙与政治改革在同一Tag任务内推进；未证实强制形成后继Tag

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 自太古之时，烟州之民便将金鳞狗头人的鳞片当作闪光的幸运符。许多外国政要都曾登上金陵群山，带着昂贵的礼物来与之交换。狗头人自己，也迟早会装点这片土地上的至高宫廷。作为好运的象征，金鳞狗头人是烟州精英们的贵宾。
description.text_en: Since time immemorial, the people of Yanshen have treasured golden kobold scales as glittering good-luck charms. Many a foreign dignitary has summited the mountains of Balrisen to acquire them, bearing extravagant gifts to exchange in return. It was only a matter of time before the kobolds themselves began to adorn the highest courts in the land. As living portents of good fortune, Goldscale kobolds are honored guests of Yanshen's elite.

description.text:
当贾赫带着金发和金矛第一次来到这片土地时，我们以为他确实是全能金山君的「天选者」。不幸的是，我们将以最可怕的方式了解到事情的真相。在他的儿子伊力萨在攻打盖邦的战役中失败后，贾赫下令将他限制在营地里，只让他执行战略任务。不幸的是，伊力萨一到那里，就听到了「山上遍地是黄金」的传言，于是他召集了一支小规模的远征军去抢劫这些财富，并将它们作为补偿交给了他的父亲。

当然，这些谣言主要是指我们。我们试图纠正他们的误解，但伊力萨对对话不感兴趣。他的军队抢走了我们仅有的一点财富，并捣毁了修道院，寻找更多的财富。在伊力萨的愤怒和失望中，他放火烧毁了许多寺院，这一骇人听闻的行为被我们的人民称为「大焚烧」。

伊力萨很快受到了惩罚，他因为犯下的罪过而被遣送回了布勒瓦尔。但我们也记得接下来发生的事情：当贾赫被暗杀后，金鳞狗头人奋起反抗，甩掉了精灵的枷锁，山泉被他们的鲜血染红。就像当时一样，我们捍卫金陵的正义热情依然比任何太阳都要炽烈。
description.text_en:
When Jaher first came to these lands, with hair and spears of gold, we thought him indeed 'Chosen' -- by almighty Balris. Unfortunately, we would learn the truth of the matter in the most awful of ways. After his son Elizar failed in the campaign against Thidinkai, Jaher ordered him confined to camp, and limited to strategic duties. Unfortunately for us, once there, Elizar encountered rumors that 'the hills were filled with gold', and gathered a small expeditionary force to loot said riches and deliver them as restitution to his father.

Of course, these rumors mostly referred to us. We attempted to correct their misunderstanding, but Elizar was not interested in dialogue. His force seized what little riches we had, and smashed the monasteries looking for more. In Elizar's fury and disappointment, he set many ablaze, a monstrous act our people remember as 'The Great Burning'.

Elizar was soon punished, sent back to Bulwar for his sins. But we also remember what happened next: when Jaher was assassinated, the Goldscale kobolds rose up to cast off the elven yoke, and the mountain springs ran red with their blood. Just as it was then, our righteous fervor in defense of Balrijin still burns brighter than any sun.

description.text: 「金龙」金山君，乐曲教使，斩除愚昧者，智者中的智者。传说中，他的到来是由一声雷鸣般的轰鸣声预告的，轰鸣声响彻大地，迫使我们的人民第一次来到地表面。借着他全能的能力，他可以吞吃我们，奴役我们，或者干脆把我们赶走；但他没有。相反，这位仁爱的典范与我们的祖先一起生活在山洞里，为我们打开了一个全新的世界。在他无数的教训之前，我们的人民只唱悲伤和哀悼的歌，只建造我们生存所需要的东西。现在，我们对着日出的金光唱他的赞歌，以他的名义在悬崖边雕刻出金碧辉煌的寺庙。虽然他和我们在一起的时间很短，但我们永远不会忘记他永恒的承诺：有一天回来，再次与我们同行。在他的鼓舞下，在金龙的旗帜下，我们以我们所有希望的目标，以及我们唯一的真神的名字命名我们的国家，金陵。
description.text_en: Balris the Gold. Bringer of Songs, Slayer of Ignorance, Wisest of Masters. The sagas record that his coming was heralded by a great and thunderous roar, cracking the groundsky and forcing our people to the surface for the first time. By his almighty power, he could have devoured us, enslaved us, or simply driven us away; but he did not. Instead, the Paragon of Benevolence lived alongside our ancestors in the mountain caves, and opened our eyes to a whole new world. Before his countless lessons, our people sung only songs of sorrow and mourning, and built only what we needed to survive. Now, we sing his praises to the golden light of the sunrise, and carve resplendent cliffside temples in his name. And though he only remained with us for a short time, we will never forget his eternal promise: To return one day, and walk alongside us once more. United in his exaltation, under the flag of the Golden Dragon, we named our nation after the object of all our hopes, and our one true god: Balrijin.

description.text: 在金陵黄金议会的英明氏族圣贤中，圣贤大师被选为所有争端的最终决定者。但是，为了仿效我们的耐心和仁慈的师父，圣贤大师往往决定保持公正。解决这种僵局的办法只有一个：武术决斗。以「龙舞」而闻名，这一神圣的传统要求我们孜孜不倦地磨练我们的技能，把我们的身体训练成辉煌的金色武器，这一切都是为了金陵的和平。当我们用这些武器对付外国侵略者时，它们将变得更加锋利。
description.text_en: Among the wise Clan Sages of the Golden Council of Balrijin, the Master Sage is chosen to act as the final decider in all disputes. But, in emulation of our patient and benevolent Teacher, Master Sages often decide to remain impartial. There can be only one way resolve such an impasse: a martial arts duel. Known as a 'Dragon Dance', this holy tradition demands we tirelessly hone our skills and train our bodies into brilliant golden weapons, all for the sake of Balrijin's blessed peace. And when we turn those weapons against foreign invaders, they will be all the sharper.

description.text: 金鳞狗头人从贵族宫廷向烟州的大城市扩散。随着时间的推移，这些散居海外的人逐渐发展成为一个联系网络和参与有利可图的规模贸易的商人。在这片土地上的市场和广场上，人们总能在人群中发现一丝金光，将金陵的珠宝和其他商品向四面八方传播开来。
description.text_en: From the noble courts, Goldscale kobolds proliferated into Yanshen's great cities. Over time, this diaspora evolved into a network of contacts and merchants involved in the lucrative scale trade. In markets and plazas across the land, one can always find a glimmer of gold shining among the crowd, spreading the jewelcrafts and other wares of Balrijin far and wide.

description.text: 「让我们面对现实吧，我们根本无法竞争！试着卖一件斗篷，他们会卖一件有金镶边的斗篷！发明一个新的小发明，他们会做出同样的东西，但更闪亮！这些蜥蜴身上都掉金子了，我们怎么能比他们做得更好！」——一个非常沮丧的侏儒明白了为什么金鳞狗头人主宰了烟州的奢侈品市场
description.text_en: 'Let's face it, we just can't compete! Try and sell a cloak, they sell a cloak with gold trim! Invent a new gizmo, they'll make the same thing but shinier! How are we supposed to outproduce these lizards when they've got gold falling off their bodies?!' - A very frustrated gnome learning why Goldscales dominate the Yanshen luxury market

description.text: 当我们第一次与西方的狗头人兄弟们建立联系时，我们被他们花哨的颜色、华而不实的文化，以及他们存在的事实所震惊。他们似乎也在讲述巨龙的故事，但所有这些邪恶的「色彩学」教给他们的是把财富藏在巨大的地下堆里。然而，最有智慧的大师教导我们，真正的正义不在于驱逐恶人，而在于化恶为义。我们将采用西方的储物传统，但不是堆积硬币和小玩意，我们将要求每个成年的狗头人提交他们的鳞片，并在背面写一条智慧之语。毕竟，我们的人民是我们真正的珍宝——而智慧是真正的财富。
description.text_en: When we first established contact with our western kobold brethren, we were shocked - by their gaudy colors, their crude culture, and the very fact of their existence. It seemed they, too recounted tales of great dragons, but all these wicked 'chromatics' had taught them was to hoard their wealth in giant underground piles. Yet the Wisest of Masters teaches us that true justice lies not in banishing the wicked, but in transfiguring evil to righteousness. We will adopt the western tradition of hoards, but rather than piling up coins and baubles, we will require every kobold who comes of age to submit one of their scales, with a piece of wisdom written on the back. After all, our people are our real treasures - and wisdom is true wealth.

player_overview.avoid_if: 只想无前置连续征服、不愿处理跨区域寻人和盟友局势的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先结盟保住两省并调和氏族，中期追踪巨龙线索与建设银行，后期推进宪制和东洲贸易影响。
player_overview.overview: 金陵是1444年的两省金鳞狗头人小国。贤者们守护金龙巴尔里斯留下的教诲，却不知道他为何失踪。你要在强邻夹缝中结盟，调和武术氏族，沿书库、山地与占卜线索寻找他；随后面对巨龙归来对旧神职权力的挑战。银行、跨族合作和议会改革让这场寻龙记不止是宗教传奇。它的代价是弱小开局与需要耐心铺开的地区任务。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢弱国寻龙、跨族外交、经济制度与政治改革相互牵动的玩家。
signature_features: 贤者议会、占卜密探与区域探索共同构成寻龙主线。
金鳞银行、金矿通胀和蓝巾会合作把外交转成经济制度。
巴尔里斯归来后推动削弱旧神职权力、建立议会共和国。
player_overview.tagline: 让金鳞狗头人找到失踪的金龙，并把脆弱贤者国建设成开放的贸易共和国。

reasons: 金龙巴尔里斯的寻访线鲜明
氏族外交和金鳞银行连接政治经济
后期从神权议会走向宪制共和国
warnings: 两省开局与强邻压力高
寻龙路线依赖跨区域外交和地点

positive_indicators: 吸纳人类辅军并维系跨族盟友
建立金鳞银行稳定金融
削弱旧神职并推动议会宪制
values.rationale: 人类辅军、跨族外交、银行稳定与宪制改革体现公共利益和人格承认；贤者特权、对命令秩序的敌意和废墟诸国依附政策降低克制。战争与扩张本身不计分。
red_flags: 寻龙早期贤者与氏族特权
后期保护废墟诸国也设想依附关系
